mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate exceeds 5.0% for three consecutive months, it signals labor market weakness that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0 for 3 months, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate broad consumer demand contraction, triggering corporate revenue revisions and negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production below 95.0 signals supply chain disruptions that increase input costs and reduce corporate margins, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when INDPRO < 95.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Rising GDP growth rate signals strong economic expansion that boosts corporate earnings and investor confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in >60% of periods when GDPC1 rises, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent inflation above 3.0% for three months signals Fed tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0 for 3 months, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Rising employment levels indicate strengthening labor markets that increase consumer spending and corporate revenue, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in >60% of periods when PAYEMS rises, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts falling below 600.0 thousand units for two months signals housing sector contraction that reduces consumer wealth and spending, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when HOUST < 600.0 for 2 months, or Rank IC < 0.03.
